state.whole_fight_sim: each option's whole_fight_sim: that line this turn, then the simulator's own play to the fight's end, 1200 samples per line on the same random numbers (25.7 s); the win rate is calibrated on logged boss fights, the difference to the best line is paired (± standard error). rollout_best is the line with the highest simulated win rate (lines within 2 standard errors of it count as tied), then the least HP lost when won (median); the 5-turn rollout's numbers stay for reference
state.boss_relative_margin_objective: Boss基准目标为S=my_dpr/boss_hp−enemy_dpr/my_hp。只在boss_evaluation明确rankingEligible=true、同Boss/同窗口且原信任闸允许时比较S及配对差，较大为目标；先满足实际存活/资源约束，不能用高均值覆盖启动前死亡。unknown、缺失归属或截断不得当0分或自行心算补齐。
state.whole_fight_plan: the simulation's best line, from its samples (information, not an order): T2 play 灵动步法; T8, T9 the enemies hit hardest (incoming ~33, ~38); drink 易伤药水 ~T2, 异鱼之油 ~T2; the boss dies ~T9 (median of 805 winning samples)
state.whole_fight_sim_trust: 低可信 (low trust): the simulator is not validated on this boss (validation fights from turn 1 (26): calibrated Brier 0.215 over 0.150 (1.25x the overall 0.120); too optimistic: forecast 64% won, 46% won in the log). Its numbers are shown only because this fight is an SL retry, to help find another approach; no option is ranked by them.

previous_attempts.note: SL retry: this fight was reloaded from its start (the game's save from entering the room) because the earlier attempt(s) below reached a certain death. The deck, the draws and the enemy moves are the same as long as the plays are the same, so playing the same way loses the same way: look for a different line (when to block, which enemy to kill first, when to drink which potion, which cards to set up). Information, not an order: the options and their numbers are unchanged and you still choose. The draw pile comes in the same order whatever you play (a card drawn earlier just arrives earlier), until the discard pile is reshuffled: known_draws lists the next cards when they are known.

state.deepseek_plan: DeepSeek's run plan (F16; advice, not orders): Retained poison pressure protected by dexterity, Weak and draw — Accelerate existing poison and improve block and draw. Keep Defends until replacements arrive; remove Clumsy and redundant Strikes. Killing the body does not finish this boss. No calibrated damage gap is available; prioritize surviving its explosion too. | boss prep: Use Fysh Oil before cards; establish Footwork and poison with opening energy. Pair Vulnerable with Skewer. Preserve HP and maximize block on the separate explosion turn.

experience.note: lessons from past runs about these enemies (experience base): evidence, not orders
lessons: [boss:WATERFALL_GIANT | confidence high, n=34] 巨兽本体、回复与结束后自爆分账，占位血不是需伤。机制：A10蒸汽T2=20后每轮+3，本体结束下轮爆，HP读250。搭配：清体与爆时实血挡合核。决定胜负的战斗：34支持/0反例，重打14场58试7赢（含断线续打），单因未控（n=34）。典型案例：3DSZM9BL9B0B A10六试同首25抽均败；末T12毒清体，T13为16血17挡对50、至少缺18血。首T16爆59，早清不等胜。旧PUY011SBWSSU两试次轮序/药时都变、余1胜，不归因单瓶。

mechanics_experience.note: lessons from past runs about the mechanics in this fight: our power cards and buffs, the enemies' own powers (experience base): evidence, not orders
lessons: [card:FOOTWORK | confidence high, n=151] 步法普通/升级建2/3敏，仅加后继牌挡、不补旧挡。机制：基础加敏后核脆弱/倍率/禁挡，换战重建。搭配：合法挡牌与启动血价同核。决定胜负的战斗：单因未控（n=151，反例0）。典型案例：VGNDNGPFYRE3千足虫T3普通步法建2敏，T4手法9/防御7，T5后空翻7/防御+10；后者暗影翻20、总27挡使3血保留，T6无挡仍死。旧KAY522KT5NXR三牌3敏各多3共27挡保8血后胜。
